title: Strengthen parser edge-case coverage
objective: Add a focused parser test matrix covering zero and nonnumeric IDs, blank labels, blank categories, extra fields, surrounding field whitespace, and case-insensitive active/inactive states. Assert exact existing ParseError variants and successful Record values. Change production only if a test exposes behavior contradicting the documented format. Required validation: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test. Non-goals: new states, parser redesign, dependencies, fuzzing, or error-message changes.
acceptance_criteria: The parser matrix covers zero and nonnumeric IDs, blank labels and categories, extra fields, surrounding whitespace, and case-insensitive active/inactive states.
Tests assert exact existing ParseError variants and successful Record values.
Production changes occur only if a test exposes behavior contradicting the documented format.
required_tests: Focused parser edge-case matrix; no fuzzing

execution_hints.effort_reason: Recovered trial contract uses the default execution depth.
